title: Port binary PLY scalar/stride/list and face sizing bodies
scope: Complete source parseBinaryBody, both endian encodings, all supported scalar aliases, fixed/list strides, two-pass faces, skipped elements and progress.
acceptance: Independently compare original/native/browser outputs and refusals for both byte orders and every scalar alias, list layout and progress boundary.
Preserve two-pass sizing/fill order and original malformed-input observations within explicit resource limits.
open_items: Fixed 166-case input corpus declared before binary implementation: both byte orders, all 16 aliases in vertices/counts/indices, list/stride/refusal/IEEE cases, four seeds per endian and both million-record progress boundaries.
Original outcomes must be captured before the first Rust comparison; exact complete PLY1 bytes and progress/refusals, no numeric tolerance.
Browser runtime, engine integration and broad P03 acceptance remain open.
